&= \left(\frac{1}{\sqrt{1+\tan^2 x}}\right) \left(\frac{1+ \tan^2 x}{\sqrt{1+\tan^2 x}}\right) \\

\[S_n = \frac{a}{1-r}, \text{ for } |r| < 1,\]

As a result, the series converges.

&= 1+\frac{\tan^4 x}{\sqrt{1+\tan^2 x}}+\frac{\tan^6 x}{\left(\sqrt{1+\tan^2 x}\right)^3}+\cdots \\
